channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about PJ Tucker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about PJ Tucker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on PJ Tucker
item.description:
#Sixers coach Doc Rivers on P.J. Tucker having knee surgery:

“We’re not that concerned by it. Listen, he’s a guy that we are really looking forward to having in the fold, and we’re going to keep him healthy all year. That’s the goal.”

Doc Rivers on PJ Tucker, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Daryl Morey on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Daryl Morey on Tucker:

“P.J. Tucker is one of the most respected and relentless competitors in our game and is the type of competitor our fans will love and embrace. We’re excited to add his leadership, toughness, defensive versatility and championship pedigree to our roster.”

Daryl Morey on PJ Tucker, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on PJ Tucker returning tonight from that injury:

“By the time I walked in the locker room,he looked me dead in the eye and said ‘don’t even think about it, I’m playing in that second half.’”

Erik Spoelstra on PJ Tucker, May 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on PJ Tucker:

“I don’t know where we’d be without him. Plus he’s paid a couple of my fines, so I’d like to keep him around.”

Jimmy Butler on PJ Tucker, May 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: James Harden on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:James Harden on PJ Tucker:

“P.J. is P.J. P.J. is P.J. Plays hard, but it’s not something that I’m worried about.”

James Harden on PJ Tucker, May 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Duncan Robinson on PJ Tucker:

“PJ is amazing. He doesn’t care about anything but that scoreboard, and he’ll do whatever it takes to win.”

Duncan Robinson on PJ Tucker, Nov 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Leandro Barbosa on PJ Tucker, Devin Booker
item.description:
former Suns guard Leandro Barbosa said.

“[Tucker is] such a great defensive player and a physical player. He took it to Devin Booker, and Devin Booker took it. I told him every time he went against P.J.: 'If you can succeed against him, you will succeed against anyone.'”

Leandro Barbosa on PJ Tucker, Devin Booker, Jul 12, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Khris Middleton on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Barbara Barker:Bucks' Khris Middleton on the job PJ Tucker has done on KD:

“Tuck has done a great job of making it tough on KD. When we see that, it’s contagious. We don’t want to let him down.”

Khris Middleton on PJ Tucker, Jun 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @meanbarb.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kevin Durant, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Giannis Antetokounmpo on PJ Tucker:

“He keeps making everything tough on KD (Kevin Durant). He’s vocal. He’s a leader. He pushes us to be great. He’s definitely a big piece of this organization and this team. He’s going to keep helping us. We definitely need him moving forward.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kevin Durant, PJ Tucker, Jun 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Steve Nash on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Steve Nash on P.J. Tucker's defense:

“He’s playing extremely physical and made it difficult. That’s his role on their team. I thought it was borderline non-basketball physical at times, but that’s the playoffs. You have to adapt and adjust.”

Steve Nash on PJ Tucker, Jun 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on PJ Tucker
item.description:
CoachMike Budenholzer on PJ Tucker’s role in Milwaukee:

“He’s just really just a lot of things we’re looking for in players.”

Mike Budenholzer on PJ Tucker, Mar 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Eric Nehm:Mike Budenholzer, on what P.J. Tucker brings to Milwaukee:

“With a veteran guy like this, I think we've all seen it, his defense is at an elite level. His ability to guard multiple positions, his ability to guard the best players in the league.”

Mike Budenholzer on PJ Tucker, Mar 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Stephen Silas on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Stephen Silas on PJ Tucker:

“We’re going to try to figure out something that works for him and works for us as far as him not being on the team anymore. I was under the assumption that he was going to play tonight and he didn’t play. That was disappointing.”

Stephen Silas on PJ Tucker, Mar 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Victor Oladipo on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Victor Oladipo (@Victor Oladipo) on PJ Tucker:

“PJ Tucker is a rarity. One of those special players that go unnoticed because he does the small things so very well. We notice it. I definitely notice it. We needed him to win these last five games. We’re gonna continue to need him if..”

Victor Oladipo on PJ Tucker, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Victor Oladipo on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Victor Oladipo on P.J. Tucker:

“We're gonna continue to need him if we're gonna win at a high level... If you are a true fan of the game, and you truly watch the game, you'll see his impact on both ends... It's really dope to be his teammate.”

Victor Oladipo on PJ Tucker, Jan 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Stephen Silas on James Harden, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas on James Harden & PJ Tucker:

“They’re not far behind at all. They’re both so smart & they both pick things up very, very quickly. As I said before, when you’re dealing with the great players they get it before everybody else does.. It wasn’t anything foreign to them”

Stephen Silas on James Harden, PJ Tucker, Dec 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Stephen Silas on James Harden, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Salman Ali:Stephen Silas on James Harden and PJ Tucker:

“There's supposed to be at practice tomorrow as far as I know. I haven't heard anything to the contrary.”

Stephen Silas on James Harden, PJ Tucker, Dec 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: David Nwaba on Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
David Nwaba:

“Right now, I haven’t seen too many of my teammates. I’ve run into PJ Tucker, Eric Gordon. Not too many guys I’ve run into right now but I’m sure they’re doing their own things, just trying to get their body right. doing the little things to keep their body in shape and to stay in shape and that’s what I’m trying to do as well. I’m just focused on just getting my body right. And just being ready for this season.”

David Nwaba on Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, Oct 13, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on PJ Tucker
item.description:
“But what we need now is for him to become a defensive force. It’s a physical league. You’ve got to be able to guard multiple guys, and he's got the ability to do that. There’s no reason why he can't become P.J. Tucker defensively. He’s got a similar body, got the strength to fend off bigger guys and he's got speed to stay in front of guards. But it takes a commitment to become that.”

Steve Kerr on PJ Tucker, Sep 26, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Joe Mussatto:Dennis Schroder on his ejection:

“It's unfortunate that I went between (P.J. Tucker's) legs, but for me, it's not on purpose. My family didn't raise me that way,to hurt somebody intentionally.”

Dennis Schroder on PJ Tucker, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @joe_mussatto.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Tilman Fertitta:

“I think we’re all excited to see sports today. I think we’re really excited to see the NBA because in the NBA we really know our players. Fans know their personalities. We’re so lucky to have the team we have. When you look at James (Harden) and Russ (Westbrook) and P.J. (Tucker) and Eric (Gordon), it’s exciting. I think we have as good a chance as anybody. I think the NBA and team owners have taken our time to make sure we did this right and it’s safe for everybody. I know that everybody is excited to play. I didn’t want to play if the players didn’t want to play and everybody’s happy to play.”

Tilman Fertitta on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, Jun 6, 2020. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on PJ Tucker, Marcus Smart
item.description:
Jay King:Mike D’Antoni on Marcus Smart:

“He’s one of the best defenders in this league. He’s like P.J. (Tucker) for us.”

Mike D'Antoni on PJ Tucker, Marcus Smart, Dec 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: James Harden on Chris Paul, Carmelo Anthony, PJ Tucker, James Ennis
item.description:
Harden said in an interview with FOX 26 Sports.

“I think last year it was great for us because we kind of built our chemistry up before training camp,and then obviously adding Chris (Paul) and adding PJ (Tucker), we got a year under our belt. Bringing other guys in, James (Ennis) and 'Melo (Carmelo Anthony), just got to get them acclimated before training camp starts, something we need.”

James Harden on Chris Paul, Carmelo Anthony, PJ Tucker, James Ennis, Aug 19, 2018. Source: FOX 26 Houston.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Meanwhile, Warriors coach Steve Kerr and his staff spent the past three days trying to find solutions for all these unique challenges.

“Well, they do a ton of switching, like we do, and they've got a lot of guys who they may not be the Greek Freak (Antetokounmpo) or (Durant), but they're good-sized guys with Trevor Ariza, PJ Tucker, Eric Gordon,”

Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, May 20, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on PJ Tucker
item.description:
ClutchFans:Mike D'Antoni:

“I tell you what... PJ Tucker is one of the best defenders I've ever seen. He guards everybody. He guards them hard... This guy... it doesn't get much better than him.”

Mike D'Antoni on PJ Tucker, Mar 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Norman Powell on PJ Tucker
item.description:
“They were subbing in P.J. (Tucker), he thought I was coming out, he was pulling my jersey,”

Norman Powell on PJ Tucker, May 7, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwane Casey on PJ Tucker
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Dwane Casey on PJ Tucker's playoff debut:

“That's one guy I don't worry about. He knows what pressure is all about. I think he'll be ready for it”

Dwane Casey on PJ Tucker, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
